cands.name: Amos Quick
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 58 (Guilford County) since January 2017. In 2016 he defeated incumbent Ralph Johnson in the Democratic primary. He has sat on the Appropriations, Environment, and Pensions and Retirement committees, among others.

endorsements.text: For 2026, Ballotpedia lists voter-guide recommendations from the GuilfordBlueNC and Waves of Democracy Sway voting groups.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he came to North Carolina. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026, and we found no campaign-site or interview statements from him on the issues.
